data.gender_notes: Ismerie is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Ismerie is the goddess of prophecy. She is often depicted holding a spear or staff topped with an owl, symbolizing wisdom and insight. In Christianity, Ismerie represents the divine guidance and wisdom bestowed upon believers. The name Ismerie carries the meaning “Goddess of Prophecy” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ismerie usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of prophecy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Ismerie belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Prophecy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ismerie total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_hebrew.name: איסמרי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: איסמרי הוא שם שמקורו בשורשים עבריים ומשמעותו 'אלוהים שמע' או 'ישמר ישראל'. השם מורכב מיסודות 'יש' ומרי' המרמזים על שמירת האל והשגחתו על ישראל. השימוש בשמות כאלה היה מקובל בקרב היהודים והנוצרים כאחד, כביטוי לאמונה בהשגחה האלוהית.

in_greek.name: Ισμερι
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ισμερι προέρχεται από εβραϊκές ρίζες και σημαίνει 'Θεός ακούει' ή 'Ακούμε από τον Θεό'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, παρόμοια ονόματα ήταν συχνά σύμβολο της σχέσης μεταξύ του ανθρώπου και του Θεού,เน้น την προσευχή και την ακρόαση του Θεού.

in_latin.name: Ismerie
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Ismerie originem in radicibus hebraicis habet et significat 'Deus audit' vel 'Audivit Deus'. In traditione christiana, nomina quae divino auditu et providentiae referuntur, saepe dabantur in signum devotionis et spei in protectione divina.

in_english.name: Ismerie
in_english.meaning: God hears or God has heard
in_english.long_meaning: The name Ismerie originates from Hebrew roots, specifically from elements meaning 'God' and 'hear'. It signifies 'God hears' or 'God has heard', reflecting a profound spiritual connection and trust in divine providence. Historically, names with similar etymologies were popular among Jews and early Christians, symbolizing faith in God's attentive care. Today, Ismerie remains a meaningful choice for parents seeking a name that embodies spiritual vigilance and hope.
